div.div: غَافِصَةٌ A sudden, or an unexpected, calamity, of time, or fortune: (Sgh, * K, * TK:) pl. غَوَافِصُ. (A.) You say, وَقَاكَ ٱللّٰهُ غَوَافِصَ الدَّهْرِ [May God preserve thee from the sudden, or unexpected, calamities of time, or fortune]. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
